mechanism_description: Direct Portfolio Learning (DPL) paradigm — features → portfolio weights를 end-to-end neural network가 직접 학습. KR equity universe 첫 적용. 입력: 634 PIT-clean features × 124 sig_dates (2016-01 ~ 2026-04, post macro-prefix + WT007 macro residue + 24m warm-up). Encoder: Transformer-lite (heads=2, dim=64, n_layers=2). Score head: Linear → R^N. Constraint projection 4-stage: ReLU long-only → Gumbel softmax τ-anneal top-K=20 → bounds clip [0, 0.20] → L1 normalize Σw=1. Loss: -E[r_p,t+1] + γ_cost·0.0015·|Δw| - λ_cvar·CVaR_5%(r_p). Walk-forward 5 windows shift-12m overlapping (2016-01 ~ 2024-12 train / 2021-01 ~ 2026-04 test). Gates: G0 PIT C1~C15 strict + G1 SR≥1.0 + G2 cor<0.5 substitution / <0.3 4th-source + G3 Harvey-t≥3.0 5 specs + G4 DSR Bailey-LdP Z≥0 (n_trials=100) + G5 cost-net Pareto + G6 AX-008 ≥ 2/3. 학술 토대: Elmachtoub-Grigas 2017 SPO+, Uysal-Li-Mulvey 2021 E2E, Wei-Dai-Lin 2023 E2EAI, Kim et al. 2025 DSL, Wang-Hasuike 2026 SPO Portfolio. 5-source consistent OOS Sharpe improvement → KR transfer high prior probability.
harvey_t_count_pending_forge: Forge cycle computes t-stats from realized test returns vs 5 spec panel using Newey-West HAC variance estimator (lag=12).
alpha_rank_corr_provenance: post-Forge cycle: DPL alpha_scores vs STR_1715_AR_on_M4_R05_overlay_PG2 alpha_scores Pearson + Spearman per sig_date, averaged over test windows. Production STR_1715 alpha at 05_Production/2.Factor_Model/2-1.STR_1715_AR_on_M4_R05_overlay_PG2/02_holdings_universe/alpha_scores_str1715_268m.parquet. Same-harness PerformanceAnalytics geometric convention (Charter v1.5 §13).
